recentItems.title: Geese on Billy Woods and Easy Star All-Stars Opening For Them
recentItems.description: For Rolling Stone’s October 2026 cover story, @Geeseband — the year’s most talked-about #rock #band — invited us into their top-secret recording and rehearsal space for their first on-camera interview since the stunning success of their 2025 album 'Getting Killed.'  Singer #cameronwinter, guitarist Emily Green, drummer Max Bassin, and bassist Dominic DiGesu reveal the status of Winter’s highly-anticipated new solo album, the secrets of their live shows, their plans for the band going forward, and much more in a free-wheeling, funny conversation with Deputy Music Editor Simon Vozick-Levinson. The Brooklyn band share early memories of listening to #pinkfloyd for the first time as teenagers, give it up to legends like the Beatles, and tell us which characters they play as in Mario Party. They also give us a very-real, definitely-not-joking tour of the rock & roll history behind their practice space. #geese
